title: Attic Scene Auctioned
content: Yesterday Christie's New York auctioned 232 images from National Geographic's art and photo collection, including my oil on canvas "The Attic Scene." It was commissioned by the Geographic for its centennial in 1988. The painting sold for $50,000, twice the high estimate, and more than three times the low estimate.Here's a link to Christie'spage.Washington Post articleabout the sale (Thanks, Martha)Previously on GJ:More about the painting and how it was created
